The wurtzite (Ga,Mn)As nanowires exhibit a low-temperature ferromagnetic coupling.
The magnetic order in the wurtzite (Ga,Mn)As nanowires is granular.
The temperature range for the ferromagnetic coupling is below 30 K.
The structure of the wurtzite (Ga,Mn)As nanowires is core-multi-shell.
The method used to grow the wurtzite (Ga,Mn)As nanowires is molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) at low temperature.
The temperature dependence of the magnetic moment of the wurtzite (Ga,Mn)As nanowire sample shows a surge below 40 K during field cooling.
The strength of the ferromagnetic spin-spin coupling in the wurtzite (Ga,Mn)As nanowires is large.
The magnetic field dependence of the signal brought about by ferromagnetic-like contaminations is sigmoidal.
The method used to remove the nanowires from the substrate is using poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA).
The advantage of using PMMA to peel off the nanowires is that it preserves their original orientation.
